I-tip Extension Install: Please book a hair extension consultation before this service

Full Bleach and Tone/Fashion Color: This service is for the client who is not already platinum blonde but wants to be! Hair must be medium brown or lighter and will be bleached from roots to ends to achieve desired result. consultation is strongly recommended prior to this service.
Long Hair Perm Specialty Wrap: Price starts at $130 depending on length of hair and number of perms used.

Altetnative Hair Consult...: We will talk about lifestyle, diagnosis, hair loss circumstances, and through this determine best options specific to you. Whether a topper or full system will be best, cap construction, sizing, density, color and style. I will educate and walk you through the "why's" behind what suits you and your hair loss journey best. Consult fee will apply to any alternative hair purchase made at consult.

Color Consultation: If you are unsure at all about your appointment, please book this 15 minute meeting with me so that I can assess your hair in person and we can decide together what the best course of action for your hair is. Alternatively feel free to reach out via ig or email to consult :)

Platinum Card: All over bleaching to get as light as possible while maintaining the integrity of the hair. There is a possibility that your hair might not lift to platinum and it might need to take sessions. If that happens, we can discuss more about pricing and how to achieve your goal. You are booking my whole day so the first bleaching session is priced at $200. Every additional bleaching session is $70. First 10 ounces of each bleaching session is free, every additional 1 ounce of bleach is $3. First 4 ounces of color are included. Every additional ounce is $5. Includes a free haircut/trim and blow out/style. Must be virgin hair or demi/semi hair color only. If while bleaching, we discover permanent or box dye, we will correct the service to a color correction. If you are concerned about not knowing what's in your hair, please book a test strand appointment.
